fields.name: edge
fields.meaning: Tree instances on the edge of the plot with some parts missing have this value set to 1 for all points. All other points have this value set to 0.

fields.name: dead
fields.meaning: Tree instances identified as dead via visual inspection have this value set to 1 for all points. All other points have this value set to 0.
